tbl_description: One row per archived CalCOFI plankton sample examined for Dungeness crab (Metacarcinus magister) megalopae in the 2008-2014 time series (A. Klemmedson): station, time, the aliquot fraction actually examined, and the sample volume. Counts are pivoted to dungeness_measurement; per-individual carapace lengths to dungeness_carapace. Position, cruise_key and grid_key are recovered by matching the source's cruise label + line/station + order of occupation to the CalCOFI site reference from swfsc_ichthyo.

Larval decapod counts per examined sample in long form: measurement_type is one of megalopae_magister, megalopae_other, zoea_cancer, zoea_other; measurement_value is the count found in the examined aliquot (NOT standardized by aliquot or volume). taxa_description carries the sorter's free-text identification notes for that count.
One row per individual Metacarcinus magister megalopa measured (24 across the whole time series): carapace length in mm, split out of the source's comma-separated 'Carapace length' cell.

Master inventory of archived CalCOFI oblique-tow plankton samples in the Dungeness range (San Francisco and north), 1949-2009, recording which had been examined for M. magister megalopae as of 2012-02-15 (E. Jones) and which had not. Sampling effort and gear metadata only — no counts. Jones reported no confirmed M. magister in the examined set.

The five archived megalopae mailed to CDFW on 2012-05-10 for independent species confirmation, with the verdict per specimen. Two were confirmed Dungeness; three were judged probable Cancer productus, which is the evidence behind this dataset's central caveat about historic 'Cancer magister' labels.
